text: **Verdict: False as a general claim.** The Wall is not visible to the unaided eye from the Moon, and from low Earth orbit it is very difficult to pick out: it is narrow and blends into the surrounding terrain. NASA describes seeing it from orbit as difficult; exceptional conditions may make a section discernible, but it is not reliably visible to the naked eye. Zoomed photographs don’t establish naked-eye visibility.
